summary: Asterisk is an open-source IP PBX system, VoIP gateway, and conference server. It allows you to route phone calls, manage extensions, and handle digital telephony traffic on your own hardware.
goodFor: It suits system administrators and telephony engineers who need to build custom voice communication infrastructure or private branch exchange networks from scratch.
watchOut: Configuring telephony routing and SIP trunks requires deep technical knowledge, and mistakes can result in misconfigured audio paths or security vulnerabilities like toll fraud.
deployNotes: As a compiled C application distributed via deb packages, it typically requires persistent storage for call logs and voicemails, and may integrate with a separate database backend for configuration data.
